title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.11570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we argue that looped Transformers need their own residual connections to prevent performance degradation as the number of iterations grows. We observe that increasing loop iterations can reduce reasoning accuracy: noisy state updates overwrite correct intermediate deductions and even undo completed solutions. This leaves subsequent iterations to recover lost information from an already degraded representation: once an error arises in an earlier loop, often as a result of long-range propagation through the recurrence, later loops find it difficult to correct. In this paper, we introduce InfiLoop, a loop-native residual connection that learns which past computations to retain and how much to accept from each new update. InfiLoop combines content-based weighting with learned temporal decay to maintain a running summary of recurrent states. translated_title: 基于循环原生注意力残差扩展至数万次测试时迭代
translated_abstract: 本文论证了循环Transformer需要其自身的残差连接，以防止随迭代次数增长而出现的性能退化。我们观察到，增加循环迭代次数反而可能降低推理准确率：带噪声的状态更新会覆盖正确的中间推论，甚至撤销已完成的解。这使得后续迭代不得不从已经退化的表示中恢复丢失的信息：一旦在较早的循环中出现错误（通常由递归中的长程传播导致），后续循环便难以将其纠正。本文提出了InfiLoop，一种循环原生的残差连接，它能够学习保留哪些过去的计算结果，以及从每次新更新中接受多少信息。InfiLoop将基于内容的加权与可学习的时间衰减相结合，以维护递归状态的滚动摘要。精确的流式递归机制使其持久聚合内存的大小在迭代过程中保持恒定。
tldr: 提出InfiLoop循环原生残差连接，通过结合内容加权与可学习时间衰减来维护递归状态摘要，使循环Transformer能够扩展到数万次测试时迭代而不出现推理性能退化。
en_tdlr: InfiLoop, a loop-native residual connection that combines content-based weighting with learned temporal decay to maintain a running summary of recurrent states, enables looped Transformers to scale to tens of thousands of test-time iterations without reasoning degradation.
